conventions: Bibliography entry labels on bibliography pages are not in-text mentions.
Unnumbered bibliography entries receive ordinal IDs only; number_explicit remains false.
Mathematical bracket expressions and numbered document structure are explicit non-mentions/non-references.
expected_identifiers are gold labels read from literal bibliography text; null means no DOI/arXiv token is present.
identity_cases use fixed provider records so identity metrics do not depend on live network responses.
